description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP: read a drive log (Testo CSV, or TUNER's own CSV) and report its channels, how many rows the VE and rf_korr calculations can use, and why the rest were left out — each reason with what to change on the next drive. Pass the BIN it was driven on for the DME's own lambda thresholds.

bin_path.description: Path to the 64 KB (65,536-byte) MSS54HP calibration partial ("0401 partial BIN") on this machine.

log_path.description: Path to a drive log CSV on this machine: a Testo MSS54 export, or a CSV TUNER exported.

use_sample.description: Use the bundled practice BIN and practice drive instead of files — to show what the tool does before the owner has files.

name: read_log
title: Read an MSS54HP drive log
